mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of the periods following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals increased supply-side activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5%, and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy coupled with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy with weak growth
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3%, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) over three months signals decreased consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of the periods following the signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is below 1% YoY, it signals a deflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
